meta_description:
ishwetarathore on August 12, 2026: "Happy Birthday to the world’s best brother ❤️🎂 @isaurabhrathore 

You are my pillar, my biggest support, and one of the greatest gifts God has given me. I’m forever grateful that you were born on this beautiful day and became such an important part of my life. 🙏❤️
 God bless you with a long, healthy, happy and successful life, and every dream in your heart come true. ✨
Happy Birthday, my brother! ❤️
Stay blessed, stay happy, always. 🙏
Love you my little baby brother ❤️👫🧿

#Happybirthdaymybrother #bestbrother #siblinglove #blessed #birthdayboy".
